title: Map component data
description: Map with markers and an optional route. centerLatitude, centerLongitude and zoom set the view; markers lists the pins; route keys draw a line through chosen markers. Marker writes are owner and admin only through MCP, which is stricter than the app (the app lets members add markers when allowAddMarkerInUsage is on).

centerLatitude.description: Latitude of the map centre in degrees. Example: 52.2297.

centerLongitude.description: Longitude of the map centre in degrees. Example: 21.0122.

zoom.description: Zoom level of the map. Higher is closer. Default 13.

markers.description: All markers on the map, each per $defs/marker. The whole list is replaced as one value (last writer wins), so read it first and write back the full list.

allowAddMarkerInUsage.description: When true, members may add markers in the app in run mode. MCP writes to markers stay owner and admin only.

routeMarkerIds.description: Ids of the markers the route passes through, in order.

routeStrokeWidth.description: Thickness of the route line in pixels. Default 3.

showRouteDistance.description: true shows the route length. Default true.

trackUserLocation.description: true shows the viewer's own location on the map. Default true.

useUserLocationInRoute.description: true includes the viewer's own location in the route. Applies only when routeEnabled is true. Default true.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

id.description: Marker id, unique in the map.

type.description: Marker role: standard, start, waypoint or destination.

createdBy.description: Public key of the member who created the marker, or ''.

createdAtMs.description: Creation time in epoch milliseconds. 0 means unset.

displayName.description: Legacy. Display name of the user.

lastUpdated.description: Legacy. ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
